integrity: The accepted-step criterion is obtained by direct substitution into the source Armijo model. Sharpness uses explicit boundary and near-boundary raw steps, and the tuning rule follows from balancing the two exact endpoint losses.
scientific_limitations: The exact factor is for the deterministic full-sample scalar quadratic specialization with zero nonsmooth regularizer. The minimax sharpness uses only the lower raw-curvature bound and may be improved when a finite upper raw-curvature bound is exploited.
title: Sharp Armijo contraction and minimax tuning on scalar Prox-SAM quadratics
